problem:
Which of the following are elementary matrices?

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 7 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,Q=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 7 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,S=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 7 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
Remember that an elementary matrix is obtained by performing exactly one elementary row operation on the identity matrix $I.$

With that in mind, let's examine our matrices.

- The matrix $P$ is not an elementary matrix because it can't be obtained from $I$ by applying only one elementary row operation.

- The matrix $Q$ is an elementary matrix because it can be obtained from $I$ by applying the elementary row operation ${R}_{2}:=7{R}_{2},$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}I & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=7{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 7 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =Q\end{aligned}
$$

- The matrix $S$ is an elementary matrix because it can be obtained from $I$ by applying the elementary row operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+7{R}_{1},$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}I & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+7{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 7 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =S\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, only $Q$ and $S$ are elementary matrices.
